title: HQ continuation (picked on 2026 H1) #3
question: Owner 2026-10-23: a strategy that trades 2+ times a week, high-quality setups, high probability and high profit - trend continuation with structure (first pullback after a directional session leg).

rules: Session: London (leg confirmed 02:00-05:00 ET, entries until 07:30).
Opening structure: the session's first 30 minutes' range.
Directional leg: the session's first 5m close beyond it, leg >= 3 x the 5m ATR(14) from the session's low (high), with a candle body >= 0.8 ATR in the leg; only the first leg of the session counts.
Entry zone: the first pullback into the leg's most recent 5m fair value gap within 60 minutes of the leg; below the leg origin first = no trade.
Trigger (within 30 minutes of the touch): a 5m close beyond the prior candle's high (long) / low (short); entry at the next 5m open + 1 tick.
Stop: 1 tick beyond the pullback's protected low (high) (6-80 pts, else no trade).
Target: the next liquidity pool in the trend direction (>= 1R), banked at 8R. Breakeven (entry + 1.25 pts) once +1R was reached.
Time exit: 15:55 ET. One trade a session.
Size: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop (max 40 micros); $1.90 a micro, 1 tick slippage on market fills.

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
